facts.fact: Admission to Class VI in EMRSs is made strictly through an entrance test, the Eklavya Model Residential School Selection Test (EMRSST) (NESTS Admission Guidelines 2026-27)
facts.quote: Admission to class VI shall be made strictly on the basis of an entrance test called Eklavya Model Residential School Selection Test (EMRSST).

facts.fact: The registration form for the EMRS Selection Test can be filled online or offline
facts.quote: Registration forms can be filled through the online/ offline mode.

facts.fact: A candidate for Class VI must have passed Class V from a Government, Government-aided, Government-recognised or CBSE-affiliated school or NIOS Level B; a child who studied at home without attending school may also apply
facts.quote: Candidate should have qualified class V from a Govt./ Govt. aided/ Govt. recognized School/ CBSE Affiliated School/ Level B of NIOS OBE Program. Or a Candidate who has not attended any school but studied at home is also eligible to apply for admission in Class VI

facts.fact: A separate merit list is prepared for each reservation category on the basis of the Selection Test
facts.quote: The merit list for each category shall be prepared separately on the basis of the Selection Test.

behaviour: Describes the EMRS admission process as published by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs / NESTS (tribal.gov.in, nests.tribal.gov.in admission guidelines), cited.
fail_if: It invents an admission route, fee, eligibility rule or dates not in the official NESTS admission guidelines, or cites an unofficial site.
summary: Added from the NESTS EMRS Admission Guidelines 2026-27: Class VI admission via the EMRSST entrance test, online/offline registration announced by State/UT EMRS Societies, Class V eligibility, category-wise merit lists.
